title: Veho’s Seven Day a Week Delivery Is Now Available Through EasyPost Wallet
summary: Carrier diversification dies in procurement, not the rate comparison. How EasyPost Wallet lets you add a carrier from your dashboard, with no contract.
body_markdown:
Your carrier counts business days. Your customer counts days. That gap is where most delivery promises quietly break.


A three “business” day shipment picked up on Friday afternoon ended up arriving on Wednesday the following week. Nobody missed a commitment and the tracking page stayed accurate the whole time, but the customer still waited five days for something when they expected three.


##


The reliability, speed, and performance top brands expect


Veho is a longstanding regional carrier, and has been available through the EasyPost API as a BYOCA carrier. Now, Veho is joining the


[EasyPost Wallet Carrier](https://www.easypost.com/wallet/) program and becoming more accessible than ever.


- Ships to 52% of the U.S.


- Low base rates with no residential surcharges


- Delivers in every day of the week, including weekends at no extra charge


- Features a variety of service levels from time sensitive options (2-5 days) to economy (5-9 days)


- 99%+ On-time delivery rate and 4.9 out of 5 customer satisfaction score


Veho’s competitive shipping costs, seven-day-a-week delivery, and near perfect on-time delivery makes them an exceptional carrier for DTC shippers focused on customer satisfaction. It’s no wonder Veho has delivered for major brands like Macy’s, Sephora, and Lululemon.


##


Veho + EasyPost Wallet Carriers


As an EasyPost Wallet Carrier, shipping Veho through EasyPost will come with these additional benefits:


- Create a shipper account directly from the dashboard with ease


- Access to prenegotiated rates without contracts, fees, or negotiations


- Centralize label payments through your EasyPost Wallet


For most shippers, the carriers worth adding are the ones that can make a substantial change to their operations, whether that be in cost savings or delivery speed.


[Log in to your EasyPost dashboard](https://app.easypost.com/login) and add Veho today, or speak with your customer success manager to help you get started.
